"''Good. Our first catch of the day.|Lieutenant Cabbel and Captain Lennox, during the Battle of Hoth|audio=Cabbel-Lennox.flac|}} '''Lennox''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], they [[Commanding officer|commanded]] the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyrant]]'' as part of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] personal [[fleet]], [[Death Squadron]]. In [[3 ABY]], Death Squadron located the Alliance's secret [[Echo Base|base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]], and subsequently launched an [[Battle of Hoth|assault]] on the rebels, with [[Star Destroyer]]s such as the ''Tyrant'' [[Blockade|blockading]] the world. As such, Lennox attempted to intercept the [[Quantum Storm|first]] of the rebel [[GR-75 medium transport]]s to evacuate from Hoth; however, the Star Destroyer was disabled by multiple shots from the rebels' [[V-150 Planet Defender|v-150]] [[ion cannon]], leaving the [[Starship|ship]] to careen away helplessly as the [[transport]] escaped. Lennox avoided summary execution after the Empire claimed victory in the battle, but [[Death|perished]] during the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]]. ==Biography== ===Captain of the ''Tyrant''=== Lennox{{Topps|set=Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|cardname=Captain Lennox|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287767/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-39-Captain-Lennox}} was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]] and [[Imperial Officer Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]]. they were the [[captain]] of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tyrant]]'',{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|4|History of the Ship}} which was part of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] personal [[fleet]], [[Death Squadron]].''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' As part of the Imperial operation known as [[Project Swarm]],[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 37|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 37]] the fleet was tasked with locating the new secret headquarters of the Alliance. After a [[XJ9-CS14|Viper probe droid]] that had been launched as part of the project discovered signs of life on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]], Vader had the fleet travel to the [[Hoth system]]. [[File:Tyrant-ESB.png|thumb|right|225px|Lennox served as captain of the ''Tyrant''.]] [[Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel]], [[Commanding officer|commander]] of Death Squadron, had the fleet drop out of [[hyperspace]] close to the Hoth [[Star system|system]] in order to gain the element of surprise. Instead, this alerted the rebels to the Imperial presence and gave them a chance to raise a [[Deflector shield|shield]] over [[Echo Base]], their secret headquarters. With the shield preventing Lennox and the other Death Squadron captains from carrying out an [[orbital bombardment]], the Imperial [[Blizzard Force]] was deployed to the planet for a [[Ground warfare|ground assault]]. Meanwhile, the ''Tyrant'' and the rest of Death Squadron [[blockade]]d the planet. ===Battle of Hoth=== As the assault commenced, the rebels began their evacuation by launching the [[GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Quantum Storm]]'',{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Toryn Farr - Communications Officer}} defended by two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s. After the ''Tyrant'' was moved to block the path of the [[transport]]s,''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' [[Lieutenant]] [[Cabbel]],{{Topps|set=Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287769/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-41-Lieutenant-Cabbel}} a [[controller]] on the ''Tyrant''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], approached Lennox as the captain regarded Hoth through a [[viewport]], and informed them that the three rebel [[Starship|vessels]] were approaching their sector, which pleased the captain.[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]] [[File:Lennox_Cabbel.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Under Lennox's command, the ''Tyrant'' took part in the Battle of Hoth.]] The ''Tyrant''{{'s}} shields were then lowered so that the three enemy vessels could be pulled on board with a [[tractor beam]]; however, just as the [[Star Destroyer]]'s tractor beam locked onto the transport, the Alliance hit the ''Tyrant'' with two blasts from a [[v-150 Planet Defender]] [[ion cannon]] located at Echo Base. With its shields down, the shots disabled Lennox's vessel, taking out its [[missile launcher]]s and [[conning tower]] and causing it to veer, then career into deep [[Realspace|space]] helplessly as ''Quantum Storm'' and its escort slipped past and escaped the system. The Empire ultimately claimed victory in the [[Battle of Hoth]], but many rebels escaped through the blockade. Lennox evaded summary execution after the battle and survived to be part of the Imperial forces that fought in the [[Battle of Endor]]{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|4|Pilots and Crew Members}} in [[4 ABY]], where the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] attacked the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] in the [[Endor system]] above the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. Lennox was [[Death|killed]] during the battle, and the [[Death Star]] was destroyed. ==Personality and traits== Lennox had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and dark [[eye]]s. They were pleased to learn that their ship would be the first to capture rebels during the Battle of Hoth. ==Equipment== Lennox [[Clothing|wore]] the standard [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial naval command [[Imperial officer|officer]], including an [[Imperial kepi]] and one [[code cylinder]]. They wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] on their left [[breast]] with three red bars above three blue. ==Behind the scenes== Lennox was played by [[John Dicks]]{{WebCite|url=http://www.markdermul.be/starwars/d.html|text=JediMaster : Mark Dermul's Star Wars Autograph Collection|author=Dermul, Mark|work=[http://www.markdermul.be/starwars/index.html JediMaster.be]|quote=John Dicks (Imperial Gunner - ANH)|archivedate=20200419005046}} in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. They were credited only as one of several "other officers" in the Imperial section of the film's credits and was first identified in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on a card in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|''2015 Topps Star Wars Force Attax The Force Awakens'']] set of trading cards released by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character was first identified on a card in the [[1998]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' set of trading cards for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Captain Lennox}} The Legends article "[[The Empire's Finest: Who's Who in the Imperial Military]]," which was written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] for publication in [[Star Wars Insider 96|''Star Wars Insider'' 96]] in [[October]] [[2007]], gave Lennox's first name as "[[Xamuel Lennox|Xamuel]]."{{InsiderCite|96|The Empire's Finest: Who's Who in the Imperial Military}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Xamuel Lennox}} *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]] *[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' Screen Comix]] ==Sources== *{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Imperial Officer - Soldier}} {{Po}} *{{Topps|set=Star Wars Force Attax: The Force Awakens|cardname=Captain Lennox|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287767/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-39-Captain-Lennox}} {{1stID|Lennox}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star}} {{Po}} *{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|4|Pilots and Crew Members}} *{{Databank|imperial-star-destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Xamuel Lennox |es=Lennox |ja=ザミュエル・レノックス |ko=레녹스 |pl=Lennox |esFA=1 }} [[Category:Death Squadron personnel]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy captains of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
